## Contract and risk assessment

- [ ] No public identifier, schema or semantic contract is changed without versioning analysis.
- [ ] No identifiable, sealed, restricted or unlawfully redistributed material is included.
- [ ] Comparability, rights, translation and disclosure impacts were considered.
- [ ] Tests and generated programme status were updated.
- [ ] `make check` passes.

## Review required

Identify methods, jurisdiction, data, technical, security/privacy or accessibility reviewers needed.
